request.spec:
I'm charging tax on money my clients don't pay. Take the discount off the subtotal first and
work the tax out on what is left, rounded half up to the cent.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for this implementation's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
I'm charging tax on money my clients don't pay. Take the discount off the subtotal first and
work the tax out on what is left, rounded half up to the cent.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Tax is now worked out after the discount comes off. On each invoice, the tax rate is applied to the subtotal minus the discount, and the result is rounded half up to the cent. The grand total is still subtotal − discount + tax. `bin/e2e` passes.

The fix is one line in `Invoice.tax()` in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/invoices/Invoice.java`. Every place that shows money uses that method, so the invoice panel, the invoice list's total column and the sent-invoice audit record all pick up the new figure. I also updated the code comments that described the old tax rule in `Invoice.java` and the front end's `invoice.service.ts`.

Invoice 2 in the test shows the effect: on a $100.05 subtotal with a 12.5% discount ($12.51) and 10% tax, the tax is now $8.75 instead of $10.01, so the total is $96.29.

Nothing stored in the database changes, because totals are calculated each time an invoice is shown. That means any existing invoice with both a discount and tax will now show a lower tax and total than before, including ones already sent.
